description: Scaffold Go backend with main.go, go.mod, health endpoint
done_when: curl localhost:8080/health returns 200 OK

description: Scaffold Astro frontend with mobile-first layout, large touch button, media display area
done_when: npm run dev serves page at localhost:4321 with visible mic button and display area

description: Create .gitignore with .env and data/ entries
done_when: git status shows .env and data/ are ignored when files exist there

description: Write scripts/source-media.sh to download CC0/public domain photos and audio for cat, dog, duck, pig, chicken, cow into data/media/
done_when: Running scripts/source-media.sh creates data/media/{cat,dog,duck,pig,chicken,cow}/set1/ each with photo.jpg, audio.mp3, and LICENSE.txt

description: Implement SQLite media database with concepts and media_sets tables, seed 6 animals
done_when: go test ./db passes with tests verifying GetRandomMediaSet returns valid data for each animal

description: Implement age encryption for media files at rest
done_when: go test ./crypto passes with tests for EncryptFile and DecryptFile roundtrip

description: Integrate whisper-server: POST /api/transcribe accepts audio blob, forwards to whisper-server
done_when: go test ./api passes with test that mocks whisper-server and verifies transcript returned

description: Implement LLM intent recognition with Anthropic tool calls: POST /api/intent
done_when: go test ./api passes with test that mocks Anthropic API and verifies subject extracted from tool call

description: Implement media lookup API: GET /api/media/{concept} returns random media set
done_when: go test ./api passes with test verifying /api/media/cat returns photo and audio URLs

description: Frontend microphone recording: MediaRecorder captures audio, sends to /api/transcribe
done_when: npm test passes with unit test mocking MediaRecorder and verifying blob sent to API

description: Frontend media display: show photo/video, auto-play audio
done_when: npm test passes with unit test verifying image renders and audio element created from API response

description: Wire up full frontend flow: button -> record -> transcribe -> intent -> media -> display
done_when: npm test passes with integration test mocking all APIs and verifying end-to-end state transitions

description: Create test fixtures: self-recorded show-me-cat.webm, CC0 mock-cat-photo.jpg, CC0 mock-cat-audio.mp3
done_when: tests/fixtures/ contains all 3 files with tests/fixtures/LICENSE.txt documenting sources

description: Create Playwright e2e test with mocked APIs verifying cat photo displays after voice command
done_when: npx playwright test passes with test from specs/architecture.md testing section

description: Setup sops for env var encryption, document decrypt-to-.env deploy process
done_when: secrets.enc.yaml exists and docs/DEPLOY.md explains sops decrypt command

description: Add webhook-deployer config for peekaboo-frontend and peekaboo-backend
done_when: pub_musings/webhook-deployer/config.yaml contains peekaboo entries and webhook triggers successful deploy

description: Research piper TTS deployment, write specs/piper.md
done_when: specs/piper.md documents installation, voice selection, and example API usage

description: Add OpenAI function calling support with provider abstraction
done_when: go test ./llm passes with tests for both Anthropic and OpenAI providers

description: Deploy peekaboo via webhook-deployer: create deploy scripts, configure systemd service, set up Caddy ingress, test webhook triggers deployment
done_when: 1) webhook-deployer/scripts/deploy-peekaboo-{frontend,backend}.sh exist and work, 2) pushing to peek1 branch triggers successful deployment, 3) peekaboo accessible via HTTPS

description: Wire up backend main.go: register API handlers, init database, add static file server for media, add CORS middleware
done_when: 1) main.go registers /api/transcribe, /api/intent, /api/media/* handlers 2) Database initialized and seeded on startup 3) Static files served from /data/media/ 4) CORS headers allow frontend access 5) go build && go test ./... passes 6) Manual test: curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/intent -d '{"text":"show me a cat"}' returns valid response

description: Wire up LLM provider abstraction: refactor api/intent.go to use llm.Provider interface instead of duplicate Anthropic code
done_when: 1) api/intent.go imports and uses llm.Provider 2) main.go creates provider from env via llm.NewProviderFromEnv() 3) Duplicate Anthropic structs removed from api/intent.go 4) go test ./... passes 5) LLM_PROVIDER env var switches between anthropic/openai

description: Integrate media encryption: serve encrypted .age files with on-demand decryption
done_when: 1) Media files stored as .age encrypted files 2) api/media.go decrypts on serving 3) scripts/encrypt-media.sh encrypts all files in data/media/ 4) age key generated and stored securely 5) go test ./... passes 6) Manual test: media endpoint returns decrypted content

description: Configure CORS properly: use ALLOWED_ORIGIN env var instead of wildcard
done_when: 1) main.go reads ALLOWED_ORIGIN from env 2) Defaults to production domain if not set 3) Development can override with localhost 4) go test ./... passes

description: Optimize SQLite configuration: WAL mode, busy timeout, connection limits
done_when: 1) db/db.go sets PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000 2) Sets journal_mode=WAL 3) Sets max open connections to 1 4) go test ./db passes

description: Create .env.example file with all required environment variables
done_when: .env.example exists with documented variables (PORT, DB_PATH, MEDIA_DIR, AGE_KEY_FILE, LLM_PROVIDER, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, WHISPER_SERVER_URL, ALLOWED_ORIGIN) and README.md references it correctly

description: Add input validation for concept ID in media API to prevent path traversal
done_when: 1) api/media.go validates concept matches ^[a-z0-9_]+$ pattern 2) Invalid concepts return 400 Bad Request 3) go test ./api passes with tests for valid/invalid concept IDs

description: Create api/media_test.go with comprehensive test coverage
done_when: 1) api/media_test.go exists 2) Tests valid concept returns media 3) Tests invalid concept returns 404 4) Tests concept validation (special chars rejected) 5) Tests empty database returns 404 6) go test ./api passes

description: Sanitize error messages in API responses to prevent info leakage
done_when: 1) api/transcribe.go returns generic error to client, logs detailed error server-side 2) api/intent.go sanitizes LLM API errors 3) All errors use consistent format 4) go test ./api passes

description: Add accessibility features to frontend: ARIA labels and live regions
done_when: 1) Mic button has aria-label describing state 2) Media display has role=region and aria-live=polite 3) Status updates announced to screen readers 4) npm test passes with accessibility checks

description: Create docs/API.md documenting all backend endpoints with request/response examples
done_when: 1) docs/API.md documents POST /api/transcribe, POST /api/intent, GET /api/media/{concept}, GET /health 2) Each endpoint has request format, response format, error codes, example curl commands 3) All examples work when tested

description: Enhance health check endpoint to verify external dependencies
done_when: 1) GET /health/live returns 200 if server running 2) GET /health/ready checks database connectivity and returns 503 if db unavailable 3) Existing /health still works 4) go test ./api passes with health check tests

description: Add minimum audio file size validation to transcribe endpoint
done_when: 1) api/transcribe.go rejects files smaller than 1KB 2) Returns 400 Bad Request with helpful message 3) go test ./api passes with test for small file rejection

description: Validate API key format in LLM provider initialization
done_when: 1) llm/provider.go NewProviderFromEnv() returns error if API key empty 2) Clear error message indicates which provider key is missing 3) go test ./llm passes with test for missing key

description: Add basic rate limiting to expensive API endpoints
done_when: 1) /api/transcribe and /api/intent have per-IP rate limit (10 req/min) 2) Rate limited requests return 429 Too Many Requests 3) Rate limiter uses in-memory store 4) go test ./api passes with rate limit tests

description: Start rate limiter cleanup goroutine to prevent memory leak
done_when: 1) main.go starts a goroutine that calls rateLimiter.Cleanup() periodically (every 5 minutes) 2) Goroutine stops on server shutdown 3) go build ./... passes 4) Comment documents the cleanup behavior

description: Add graceful shutdown with signal handling
done_when: 1) main.go traps SIGINT and SIGTERM 2) Calls server.Shutdown() with 30s timeout 3) Closes database connection gracefully 4) Logs shutdown progress 5) go build ./... passes

description: Add security headers middleware
done_when: 1) Middleware adds X-Frame-Options: DENY 2) Adds X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff 3) Adds X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block 4) Applied to all routes 5) go test ./api passes with header verification test

description: Add keyboard support for mic button (Enter and Space)
done_when: 1) MicButton responds to keydown Enter and Space to start recording 2) Responds to keyup Enter and Space to stop recording 3) Button has tabindex=0 if not already focusable 4) npm test passes with keyboard event tests

description: Add whisper-server connectivity check to /health/ready endpoint
done_when: 1) /health/ready makes HEAD or GET request to whisper-server health endpoint 2) Returns 503 if whisper-server unreachable 3) Response includes whisper status in JSON 4) go test ./api passes with whisper health check test

description: Add structured logging with slog: log levels, request IDs, JSON output
done_when: 1) Replace log.Printf with slog calls 2) Add request ID middleware 3) Log level configurable via LOG_LEVEL env 4) JSON output in production mode 5) go test ./... passes

description: Add max text length validation to POST /api/intent endpoint
done_when: 1) api/intent.go rejects text > 500 characters 2) Returns 400 Bad Request with message 3) go test ./api passes with length validation tests

description: Add retry with exponential backoff to frontend API calls
done_when: 1) Frontend retries failed API calls up to 3 times 2) Exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) 3) 429 responses trigger backoff 4) npm test passes with retry tests

description: Add max audio file size validation (5MB) to transcribe endpoint
done_when: 1) api/transcribe.go rejects files > 5MB 2) Returns 413 Payload Too Large 3) go test ./api passes with size limit tests

description: Document HTTPS requirements and TLS configuration in docs/DEPLOY.md
done_when: 1) docs/DEPLOY.md has HTTPS section 2) Documents Caddy auto-HTTPS 3) Documents certificate handling 4) Warns against HTTP in production

description: Add request timing metrics to API handlers
done_when: 1) Log request duration for all API endpoints 2) Include endpoint name, status code, duration_ms 3) Structured log format 4) go test ./... passes
